Notes_and_Tips: Maintain consistent meal timing to support thyroid balance.
Start meals with paneer or curd before eating rice.
Avoid skipping meals, especially with field work activity.
Keep dinner lighter to support metabolism and sleep.
Daily movement and consistency will improve energy and overall health.
